text: Installing contingent capital can be more efficient than raising capital requirements, because the capital injection becomes available only when it is needed and only enough securities convert to recapitalize the firm.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1998455

isBasedOn.name: Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance

abstract: Installing contingent capital could be more efficient than raising capital requirements because the capital injection is available only when it is needed.
